This lighting casts long, bold, dramatic shadows across the marble walls and ceiling, emphasizing the oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere. The marble floor is highly reflective, catching the warm light and the subject's reflections.

**Composition & Style:** Full-body shot captured from a slightly low-angle perspective to maximize the sense of vulnerability and drama. The composition utilizes moderate depth of field, keeping Jasmine sharply focused while allowing the background to recede into soft, luxurious shadow. Extreme attention must be paid to rendering: detailed skin texture with realistic reflections of tears/sweat, intricate marble veining, metallic highlights on the gold chains and embroidery, and fine details in the silk fabric.

**Secondary Elements:** In the deep background, dark, heavy wooden furniture and opulent velvet curtains block access to other rooms, enhancing the sense of confinement. At the far right edge of the frame, the faint, dark shadow or hem of an imposing male figure (the Sultan) is visible, subtly suggesting his powerful presence without full revelation.

**Technical Specifications:** Vertical orientation (9:16 aspect ratio). High-resolution cinematic photorealism. Saturated contrast between the rich emerald/gold tones and the cool, deep shadows of the marble. Atmosphere: Dramatic, oppressive, luxurious, and intensely emotional.
